theorems.name: Submission.gaussGreenRep_riesz_zero_extension_functional
theorems.statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) (U : Set (Rn N)) (Λ : (Rn N → Rn N) → ℝ), IsOpen U → (∀ g h : Rn N → Rn N, Continuous g → HasCompactSupport g → tsupport g ⊆ U → Continuous h → HasCompactSupport h → tsupport h ⊆ U → Λ (g + h) = Λ g + Λ h) → (∀ (c : ℝ) (g : Rn N → Rn N), Continuous g → HasCompactSupport g → tsupport g ⊆ U → Λ (c • g) = c * Λ g) → (∀ K : Set (Rn N), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ g : Rn N → Rn N, Continuous g → tsupport g ⊆ K → (∀ x, ‖g x‖ ≤ 1) → Λ g ≤ C) → ∃ L : C_c(U, Rn N) →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ, (∀ K : Set U, IsCompact K → ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ f : C_c(U, Rn N), (∀ x, ‖f x‖ ≤ 1) → tsupport f ⊆ K → L f ≤ C) ∧ ∀ g : Rn N → Rn N, Continuous g → HasCompactSupport g → tsupport g ⊆ U → ∃ f : C_c(U, Rn N), (∀ y : U, f y = g ↑y) ∧ L f = Λ g
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
